The counted ASCII-platform u_UCharsToChars release path now preserves source NUL substitution for non-invariant units; the key/type witness independently matches all65536 conversion outputs. Native debug assertions, EBCDIC, remaining conversion APIs, general UnicodeString extraction/FixedString allocation, ABI and full locale/calendar service integration remain uncertified or pending. Original ICU78.3 CharString now uses its actual single header-owned MaybeStackArray<char,40> byte storage and CPP-defined methods, preserving counted/NUL inputs, status guards, source growth hints, writable append-buffer commits, self-append reallocation, signed64 decimal output, invariant conversion, counted search, extraction/termination, move/copy/alias ownership and pinned POSIX separators. Empty-piece copy preserves the stale first byte (CALC-470); owning orphanOrClone reports the input length even when it differs from capacity (CALC-471). 819 sequences/2416 complete initialized snapshots match unchanged original library methods and header templates, with private visibility opened only for observation. StringPiece NUL length uses its original CPP responsibility; default/counted/borrowed fields remain in its header owner. Nullable zero-count invariant inputs preserve native no-read behavior. Managed byte storage does not certify physical allocation failure/free/stack ABI, uninitialized tails, moved-from contents, unreadable/overlapping spans or invalidated borrows.
